input.vendorSourceHashStatus: Inherited from the fixed existing package manifest; the original vendor CSV is not reread.

metadata.referenceQuoteBasis: midpoint accumulated independently from each canonical bid/ask tick
metadata.sourceSides: Per-bar Bid and Ask OHLC, first/last actual timestamp and observation count retained in sourceBars.
metadata.gapPolicy: No fabricated empty M15 bars. Every original >90-second gap retained; weekend candidates remain unverified, never upgraded to verified closure. Observed OHLC is not a claim of complete tick coverage.
metadata.pathSemantics: Opening plus 24 deterministic 37.5-second anchors. Reference path is simulated, not genuine Bid/Ask ticks or a claim of professional lookahead-free backtesting. M1/M5 use exact boundary interpolation and interior anchor extrema; only reached portions are exposed.
metadata.boundaryOrder: At a shared timestamp process the old M15 close first, then the next M15 open. Never merge the next open into the preceding bar.

approvedUse.scope: Existing Kurumi anonymous game and existing audience only; deterministic USDJPY M15 derivation and simulated intrabar reference path.
